text: Przepraszam, I'm fostering a baby girl, she's 3 months old, and tonight her temp is 38.6. I'm a bit panicky, jestem przerażona szczerze mówiąc. Earlier she bumped her head on the edge of the coffee table while I was holding her and turning round. She cried straight away, really loud, and now she's acting totally normal, like nothing happened. Her breathing is fine, normal, I've been watching her chest. I need to know how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give her, ile dokładnie? I don't want to get it wrong, she's so small
